WITH sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period p, w.fulfilment_type ft, sum(f.net_amount) net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8 AND (f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2,3))
  GROUP BY ALL),
ret AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period p, w.fulfilment_type ft, sum(r.refund_net) refund, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
  GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT s.p, s.ft, s.net, r.refund, r.n, r.nd, s.net-coalesce(r.refund,0) net_after
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (p, ft) ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, w.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
    AND (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3))
),
sales AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period,
         sum(net_amount) AS web_net,
         sum(CASE WHEN fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS cc_net
  FROM web_lines GROUP BY 1, 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
         sum(r.refund_net) AS web_refund,
         sum(CASE WHEN w.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS cc_refund
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 6 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.fiscal_period,
       round(100 * (s.cc_net - r.cc_refund) / (s.web_net - r.web_refund), 1) AS click_and_collect_share_pct,
       round(100 * s.cc_net / s.web_net, 1) AS before_returns_pct
FROM sales s JOIN refunds r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period)
ORDER BY 2
